rules.description: OAuth2 app list only shows apps owned by the authenticated user
rules.action: Only apps with uid matching Doer.ID are returned

rules.description: Client secret is hidden when listing OAuth2 applications
rules.action: ClientSecret set to empty string for each app in list
rules.code_snippet: apiApps[i].ClientSecret = "" // Hide secret on application list

rules.description: Builtin OAuth2 applications cannot be deleted
OAuth2 app GET verifies ownership by comparing UID to Doer.ID
rules.action: Return 404 Not Found to prevent information leakage

rules.description: Redirect URIs must be valid URLs or use custom OAuth2 schemes
rules.condition: URI scheme not in valid URLs and not in setting.OAuth2.CustomSchemes
rules.action: Return 400 with invalid redirect URI message

rules.description: Builtin OAuth2 applications cannot be updated
Update always regenerates client secret with bcrypt hash
rules.action: Generate 32 random bytes, encode as gto_ prefixed base32, bcrypt hash stored in DB

rules.description: User repo list shows private repos only if requester is signed in
rules.action: Private repos included in query when user is authenticated

rules.description: Repos filtered by permission - only repos with any unit access shown
rules.action: Only repos where user is admin or has unit access are included in response

rules.description: Registration token reuses existing active token or creates new one
rules.condition: Token not found (ErrNotExist) or token.IsActive is false
rules.action: Create new token, deactivating all old tokens for same owner/repo
